build: Modwerk's linker: the released core-ar2 0.3 (6b97dfb3…3e58) + this folder's compiled Silent Pad+Trig 0.5.0-experimental, materialised against the owner's stock OS 1.74, --version PS07
conditions: Headless cold boot; four held NO presses clear the missing-calibration notices; GLOBAL, six DOWNs and YES open CONTROL; two DOWNs and YES open SEQUENCER CONFIG; three DOWNs move to SILENT PAD+TRIG (both rows unchecked) and YES checks it; DOWN moves to SILENT LIVE REC and YES checks it; four NOs leave the menus; pad SD is pressed (silent: the play routine returns before the trigger, no MIDI out), then FUNC + SD (plays, MIDI note velocity 127). Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified. A second identical run gave all 28 frames byte for byte. control-menu.png and silent-press.png are byte-identical to PS06's.
